notes.title: Gnome Attacks
notes.notes: [p]Work has continued on our run up to release. [/p][p][/p][p]Many bugs have been fixed and new features added. [/p][p][/p][p]Enemies and obstacles you encounter on your journey now have a chance to join the Gnomes during their nightly raid on the Village. [/p][p][/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Gnomegeddon is Upon Us!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that Adorable Dog: Gnomegeddon is launching soon! [/p][p]Get ready to bark, bite, and Shoot your way through wave after wave of menacing garden gnomes. You’ll play as the most lovable (and lethal) dog hero, taking the fight from lush forests to the deep sea, space , and into scorching deserts. [/p][p]It’s full-blown gnome mayhem, and you’re the four-legged fury bringing the chaos.[/p][p]Wishlist now and prepare for the Gnomegeddon![/p]
